name: components/marquee
description: A lightweight looping marquee container for continuously scrolling repeated content in horizontal or vertical direction. Supports reverse direction, pause-on-hover behavior, configurable repeat count, and theme-aware class overrides.
useCases: Showcase partner logos or customer badges in an infinite strip
Display announcements, highlights, or ticker-like status messages
Build decorative motion sections in landing pages
Create continuously scrolling card rails for feature teasers
